narration: Everyone's been grinding toward 750, thinking that's the magic number. But banks don't care about 750 — they care about 760. And that gap costs you.
visual: Large '750' text in red on dark background animates in, then transforms/swaps dramatically into '760' in blue. Animated underline. 'BANKS USE A DIFFERENT CUTOFF' fades in below.

narration: Banks have secret pricing tiers, and 760 is exactly where the best mortgage rates unlock. One point below that line — even 759 — and you're in a more expensive bracket.
visual: SVG bank building on light background. Three animated tier rows slide in: '760+ → BEST RATE' in green, '720–759 → HIGHER RATE' in amber, '580–719 → HIGHEST RATE' in red. 760+ row highlighted with blue border.

narration: On a $400,000 home loan, the gap between 759 and 760 adds up to $23,000 extra in interest over the life of the loan. That's your bank's bonus — not yours.
visual: SVG house on dark background. Two growing side-by-side bars: '760+ — $265K interest' in green and '759 — $288K interest' in red. '$23,000 GAP' badge appears below in red.

narration: Here's the wild part — 31% of Americans have scores between 700 and 759. Most have no idea they're in the wrong pricing tier right now.
visual: Animated circular progress arc on light background fills to 31% in blue. '31%' counts up inside the ring. Five person silhouettes appear below — one highlighted in blue to represent the one-in-three stuck below 760.

narration: Two fastest moves to cross that line. Number one, get your credit utilization below 6%. Number two, request a credit limit increase — no new accounts, just one phone call.
visual: Credit card SVG on dark background with utilization bar animating down from 30% to 6% and turning green. Below it, a phone icon appears with 'REQUEST HIGHER LIMIT' text — 'NUMBER TWO' label fades in.

narration: Pull your score right now. If you're anywhere between 700 and 759, there's $23,000 sitting between you and the next tier. Don't leave it there.
visual: Animated score counter climbs from 750 to 760 on light background — color shifts from red to green as it crosses. '$23,000 SAVED' badge springs in. CTA text: 'Follow for daily money moves that actually move the needle.'
